result.rationale: Mild lateral ankle sprain with no Ottawa ankle rule red flags (no malleolar or midfoot tenderness, no deformity, numbness, or wound). Advise trying a few steps; if able to bear weight for four steps, use rest, ice, compression, elevation, and over-the-counter analgesia. Seek in-person evaluation if unable to bear weight, or if pain, swelling, or bruising worsen over the next 48–72 hours.
